pois.description: La colección presenta obras de arte argentino desde el siglo XIX hasta la actualidad, y un sector destacado con obras de artistas internacionales del siglo XVI hasta el XX seleccionadas por la fundadora. Objetos de la antigüedad egipcia y griega
pois.wikipedia: es:Colección de Arte Amalia Lacroze de Fortabat
pois.intro: The AMALITA Collection officially the Amalia Lacroze de Fortabat Art Collection is an art museum in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

pois.name: Buque Museo Corbeta A.R.A. Uruguay
pois.address: 500 Avenida Alicia Moreau de Justo, Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, 1144, AR
pois.description: Es el buque argentino más antiguo botado en 1874. Comprado por el presidente Domingo Farmiento Sarmiento. Integró la flota de hierro y vapor de nuestro país. Fué buque escuela. Sembró soberanía. En 1903 rescató la expedición científica del Dr. Otto Norde
pois.intro: The corvette ARA Uruguay, is a floating museum ship, berthed at Puerto Madero in Buenos Aires, Argentina. It was built in England and commissioned into the Argentine navy in 1874: it was decommissioned in 1926.

pois.name: Güerrín
pois.address: 1368 Avenida Corrientes, Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, AR
pois.intro: Güerrín is a pizzeria in Buenos Aires, Argentina, where the speciality of the restaurant is the Argentine pizza. Guerrin was declared by the Buenos Aires City Legislature as one of the most iconic pizzerias of the city in 2011.

pois.name: El Cuartito
pois.address: 937 Talcahuano, Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, AR
pois.description: Histórica y tradicional pizzería, fundada en 1934.
pois.intro: El cuartito es una pizzería tradicional de Buenos Aires, fundada en 1934. Entre sus comensales se encuentran Anibal Troilo,​ Diego Maradona y Franco Colapinto,​ entre otros.

pois.name: Plazoleta Helen Keller
pois.intro: Helen Adams Keller was an American author, disability rights advocate, political activist and lecturer. Born in West Tuscumbia, Alabama, she lost her sight and her hearing after a bout of illness when she was 19 months old.

pois.name: María Eva Duarte de Perón
pois.intro: María Eva Duarte de Perón, better known as Eva "Evita" Perón, was an Argentine politician, activist, and actress who served as First Lady of Argentina from June 1946 until her death in July 1952, as the wife of Argentine President Juan Perón. She was born into poverty in the rural village of Los Toldos, in the Pampas, as the youngest of five children.

pois.name: Raúl Alfonsín
pois.intro: Raúl Ricardo Alfonsín was an Argentine lawyer and statesman who served as president of Argentina from 10 December 1983 to 8 July 1989. He was the first democratically elected president after the National Reorganization Process.

pois.name: Luis Federico Leloir
pois.intro: Luis Federico Leloir was an Argentine physician and biochemist who received the 1970 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for his discovery of the metabolic pathways by which carbohydrates are synthesized and converted into energy in the body.

pois.name: Plazoleta Ciudad de Lakewood
pois.intro: Lakewood is a suburban city in Los Angeles County, California, United States. The population was 82,496 at the 2020 census.

pois.name: M4 Sherman
pois.intro: The M4 Sherman, officially Medium Tank, M4, was the medium tank most widely used by the United States and Western Allies in World War II. The M4 Sherman was reliable and well adapted to mass production. Tens of thousands were distributed through the Lend-Lease program to the British Commonwealth, Soviet Union, and other Allied Nations.

pois.name: Domingo Faustino Sarmiento
pois.intro: Domingo Faustino Sarmiento was President of Argentina from 1868 to 1874. He was a member of a group of intellectuals, known as the Generation of 1837, who had a great influence on 19th-century Argentina.

pois.name: Francisco Solano López
pois.intro: Francisco Solano López Carrillo was a Paraguayan statesman, military officer and politician who served as President of Paraguay from 1862 to 1870, of which he served mostly during the Paraguayan War. He is the only Paraguayan president to have been killed in action.

pois.name: Bartolomé Mitre
pois.intro: Bartolomé Mitre was an Argentine general, statesman and author. He was President of Argentina from 1862 to 1868 and the first president of unified Argentina.

pois.name: Casa Rosada
pois.address: 50 Balcarce, Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, C1064AAB, AR
pois.intro: The Casa Rosada, lit. 'the pink house', is the president of the Argentine Republic's official workplace, located in Buenos Aires. The palatial mansion is known officially as Casa de Gobierno.

pois.name: Teatro Colón
pois.address: 628 Cerrito, Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires
pois.intro: The Teatro Colón is a historic opera house in Buenos Aires, Argentina. It is considered one of the ten best opera houses in the world by National Geographic.

pois.name: Victoria Ocampo
pois.intro: Ramona Victoria Epifanía Rufina Ocampo was an Argentine writer and intellectual. Best known as an advocate for others and as publisher of the literary magazine Sur, she was also a writer and critic in her own right and one of the most prominent South American women of her time.

pois.name: Silvina Ocampo
pois.intro: Silvina Ocampo was an Argentine short story writer, poet, and artist. Ocampo's friend and collaborator Jorge Luis Borges called Ocampo "one of the greatest poets in the Spanish language, whether on this side of the ocean or on the other." Her first book was Viaje olvidado, translated as Forgotten Journey, and her final piece was Las repeticiones, published posthumously in 2006.

pois.name: Pedro Aramburu
pois.intro: Pedro Eugenio Aramburu Silveti was an Argentine Army general and the President of Argentina from 1955 to 1958. He was a major figure behind the Revolución Libertadora, the military coup against Juan Perón in 1955.

pois.name: Nicolás Avellaneda
pois.intro: Nicolás Remigio Aurelio Avellaneda Silva was an Argentine politician and journalist, and President of Argentina from 1874 to 1880. Avellaneda's main projects while in office were banking and education reform, leading to Argentina's economic growth.

pois.intro: The National Museum of Fine Arts is an Argentine art museum in Buenos Aires, located in the Recoleta section of the city. The Museum inaugurated a branch in Neuquén in 2004.

pois.intro: The Cabildo of Buenos Aires is the public building in the city of Buenos Aires, Argentina, that was used as a seat of the town council during the colonial era and the government house of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata.

pois.intro: The National Historical Museum is a museum located in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and is a museum dedicated to the history of Argentina, exhibiting objects relating to the May Revolution and the Argentine War of Independence. The museum is under the guidance of the Secretariat of Culture.

pois.intro: Plaza San Martín is a park located in the Retiro neighbourhood of Buenos Aires, Argentina. Situated at the northern end of pedestrianized Florida Street, the park is bounded by Libertador Ave.

pois.name: Plaza Monserrat
pois.intro: Monserrat or Montserrat is a neighbourhood in the east of the Buenos Aires CBD. The district features some of the most important public buildings in Buenos Aires, including city hall, the city legislature, Casa Rosada, the Colegio Nacional de Buenos Aires and the Libertador Building, among others.

pois.name: Plaza Fuerza Aérea Argentina
pois.intro: Plaza Fuerza Aérea Argentina is a square located in the barrio of Retiro in Buenos Aires, Argentina. The square is located between the Retiro railway station on Avenida Dr.

pois.intro: The Buenos Aires Botanical Garden is a botanical garden located in the Palermo neighborhood of Buenos Aires in Argentina. The garden is triangular in shape, and is bounded by Santa Fe Avenue, Las Heras Avenue and República Árabe Siria Street.

pois.name: Reserva Ecológica Costanera Sur
pois.intro: Buenos Aires Ecological Reserve, also known as the Costanera Sur Ecological Reserve, is a 865-acre tract of low land on the Río de la Plata riverbank located on the east side of the district of Puerto Madero in Buenos Aires CBD, Argentina.

pois.name: Plaza del Congreso
pois.intro: Plaza del Congreso is a public park facing the Argentine Congress in Buenos Aires. The plaza is part of a 3 hectare open space comprising three adjoining plazas to the east of the Congress building.

pois.name: Plaza de la República
pois.intro: Plaza de la República is a city square in Buenos Aires, capital of Argentina. It is located in the San Nicolás quarter, at the intersection of the city's three main arteries: Ninth of July Avenue, Corrientes Avenue, and Diagonal Norte.

pois.name: Plazoleta Eloy Alfaro
pois.intro: José Eloy Alfaro Delgado often referred to as "The Old Warrior," was an Ecuadorian politician who served as the President of Ecuador from 1895 to 1901 and from 1906 to 1911. Eloy Alfaro emerged as the leader of the Liberal Party and defined the party while he lived.

pois.intro: The Mitre Museum in Buenos Aires, Argentina, is a museum dedicated to Argentine history, as well as to the legacy of former President of Argentina, Bartolomé Mitre. The museum building is a Spanish colonial house built in 1785.

pois.intro: ARA Presidente Sarmiento is a museum ship in Argentina, originally built as a training ship for the Argentine Navy and named after Domingo Faustino Sarmiento, the seventh President of Argentina. It is considered to be the last intact cruising training ship from the 1890s.

pois.address: Avenida Antártida Argentina, Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires, C1104ACC, AR
pois.description: Está situado en el antiguo hotel de inmigrantes (1911-1953). Valora el conjunto arquitectónico, destacando la importancia histórica, cultural, económica y social del fenómeno inmigratorio en el país.
pois.intro: Das Museo de la Inmigración ist das nationale argentinische Einwanderungsmuseum in Buenos Aires. Es befindet sich im Gebäude des ehemaligen Hotel de Inmigrantes.

pois.name: Cementerio de la Recoleta
pois.intro: La Recoleta Cemetery is a cemetery located in the Recoleta neighbourhood of Buenos Aires, Argentina. It contains the graves of notable people, including Eva Perón, presidents of Argentina, Nobel Prize winners, the founder of the Argentine Navy, and military commanders such as Julio Argentino Roca.

pois.intro: The National Congress of Argentina is the legislative branch of the government of Argentina. Its composition is bicameral, constituted by a 72-seat Senate and a 257-seat Chamber of Deputies.

pois.intro: Palacio Barolo is a landmark office building, located at 1370 Avenida de Mayo, in the neighborhood of Monserrat, Buenos Aires, Argentina. It stood as Buenos Aires' tallest building for more than a decade until the construction of the Kavanagh Building in 1936.
